claim_boundary: The third policy uses the D4 R6D likelihood graph, not the Lab 002 phenomenological binary-herald likelihood. It tests the Lab 002 posterior-LLR matching principle on D4. A nonconverged but finite 40-iteration BP iterate is decoded exactly as the Lab 002 default policy would; convergence is reported rather than silently repaired. The unscreened local graph is not an exact D4 posterior or a scalable-BP validation. This is a 100-history default-cell flux-only pilot, not an LER, second-stage, threshold, or scalable-accuracy result.
